name: Onna Ninja Azusa vs Orc 2 ~Injuu-tachi no Utage~
original_name: 女忍者アズサvsオーク2 ~淫獣たちの宴~
source:
About a year ago, Mikage Azusa, a ninja belonging to the ninja group "Oboro", infiltrated a base of the huge criminal organization "Meigas". In that base, she encontered the "Orc", a biological weapon created by the scientists of Meigas.

Getting caught in Meigas' trap, Azusa becomes a prisoner and ends up as a breeding partner for the orc breeding experiments. 

After being raped for a few months by the seemingly inexhaustible reproductive instincts of the orc, Azusa is finally impregnated by the orc and ends up giving birth to its child.

After a deadly battle, Azusa took down both the Orc and her child, however a new life was already dwelling in her womb.

A few months later, the number of orcs started to increase dramatically in the Kanto area.

Against the incredible regenerative abilities of the orcs that cannot be taken down with conventional weapons, the Japanese government gives up on their extermination and start the "East Japan Great Blockade Operation".

Inside the sealed Kanto area, the Orcs kill the men and rape the women...

In the center of the sealed area, there was 2nd "Lord" that Azusa gave birth.
translation:
大约一年前，属于忍者团体“Oboro”的忍者御影梓潜入了巨大犯罪组织“Meigas”的基地。在那个基地里，她遇到了梅加斯科学家创造的生物武器“兽人”。

阿祖萨陷入了梅加斯的陷阱，成为了囚犯，并最终成为兽人繁殖实验的繁殖伙伴。

在被兽人看似无穷无尽的生殖本能强奸了几个月后，阿祖萨终于被兽人怀孕并生下了它的孩子。

经过一场殊死的战斗，阿苏莎杀死了兽人和她的孩子，但新的生命已经在她的子宫里居住。

几个月后，关东地区的兽人数量开始急剧增加。

面对兽人不可思议的再生能力，无法用常规武器消灭，日本政府放弃了消灭兽人的念头，开始了“东日本大封锁行动”。

在被封锁的关东地区，半兽人杀男奸女……

封印区域的中央，有着梓所生下的第二个“领主”。
